name: Star Guardian BGM - Vocals
creator: matthewchasm
description:
CHECK RELEASES FOR VERSIONS!!! A different version of a scuffed Star Guardian bgm using Summoner's Rift Updated Theme Music. To use, go to settings > sounds (under in-game tab if on client) > set Summoner's Rift Theme Music to Updated (scroll to bottom). Featuring Burning Bright, Everything Goes On, Fates Fall, Light & Shadow and Endless Starlight songs. Alternate version: [https://runeforge.dev/mods/a33ce5f7-9caa-4b14-afb0-7c7a84ec0136/releases](https://runeforge.dev/mods/a33ce5f7-9caa-4b14-afb0-7c7a84ec0136/releases)
